issues: Metamorphic probes instantiate NetworkSedimentTransporter without the required flow_director argument shown in the public __init__ signature.
Probes use DataRecord.add_variable and a NetworkModelGrid constructor call that are not evidenced by the inventory/public API and may not run.
Brief does not state which probes are expected to fail before the repair.
The volume-conservation invariant is too absolute if abrasion or boundary export changes parcel volume; it should include boundary flux and any abrasion loss.
suggested_fixes: Construct and pass the required flow director to NetworkSedimentTransporter in every probe.
Build parcels using the documented DataRecord constructor/items/variables/time pattern and a valid single-link NetworkModelGrid.
Explicitly mark which probes should fail on the unpatched code, such as velocity finiteness, position bounds, or outlet handling.
Restate the invariant as a sediment volume/mass balance that accounts for boundary outflow and abrasion rather than strict constant total parcel volume.

issues: Volume-balance probe relies on off-network parcels remaining in the DataRecord and does not explicitly compute boundary outflow.
Some probes use fixed step counts to force parcel exit, which may be brittle if transport velocity is low.
Probes mix dataset attribute and item access styles; Engineer should verify both work with the DataRecord API.
